fields.title: Measure whether parsing chapters as strict XHTML removes unverified chapters
fields.description: Investigation first (Blurby.Brain1 D4 ruling, 2026-11-03). Run BLOCK-TEXT-ORDER-1's B5 certify checker over 20 named Project Gutenberg EPUBs (owner approved the download, 2026-11-03) and count uncertified sections by reason (D1, D2, D4, other), before and after a scratch-branch prototype where main parses section XHTML in xmlMode. Answer the traps: lenient htmlparser2 xmlMode, HTML entities without a DTD, tag-name case vs BLOCK\_TAGS, and the self-closing anchor and table cases on real files. Decision rule: a meaningful D4 share ships in the same renumbering event as WORD-INDEX-UNIFY-1 with one position migration; a negligible share is rejected with the numbers.
fields.notes: origin: owner rule 6c (fix the cause) and Blurby.Brain1 ruling Brain1.UNCERTIFIED-ANCHOR-HOLD-1.and-D4.2026-11-03.md. Corpus: 20 Project Gutenberg EPUBs, named in the spec, downloaded to RodneySr only for this measurement; the owner's library is never read. Stub; spec to follow.
